verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Rainforest issues long-lived server API keys and short-lived component session credentials, capped at 24 hours. None of it documents permission scopes, restricted key roles, or least-privilege API credentials an agent could be given. Component sessions are a time-limited credential for embedded UI components, which is an adjacent feature, not scoped API credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
